question: How do I track my order?
answer: You can track your order from My Orders. Click on the order to see live tracking details and the expected delivery date.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item and click Cancel. Orders can be cancelled any time before they are shipped.

question: What is the return policy?
answer: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging. Electronics have a 7-day replacement-only policy.

question: How can I return my order?
answer: Open My Orders, select the item, click Return or Replace, choose a reason and schedule a pickup. Our courier will collect it from your address.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days after the returned item passes quality check. UPI and wallet refunds are usually faster.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: We accept UPI, credit cards, debit cards, net banking, wallets, EMI and Cash on Delivery for eligible orders.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for orders up to Rs. 50,000 in most serviceable pin codes.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 6 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 days in metro cities.

question: Is there a delivery charge?
answer: Delivery is free for orders above Rs. 499. A charge of Rs. 40 applies to smaller orders.

question: How do I change my delivery address?
answer: You can change the delivery address from My Orders before the item is shipped. After shipping, address changes are not possible.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: Yes. All electronics come with the manufacturer's warranty, usually 1 year. Warranty details are shown on each product page.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can chat with us 24x7 from the Help Centre or call 1800-123-4567 between 9 AM and 9 PM.

question: Can I exchange my product?
answer: Yes, eligible products can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery from My Orders using the Replace option.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: Enter the coupon code on the checkout page in the Apply Coupon box and click Apply. The discount will be shown before payment.

question: My product arrived damaged. What should I do?
answer: We are sorry! Please raise a replacement request within 48 hours from My Orders with photos of the damaged product. We will send a replacement free of cost.

question: Is EMI available?
answer: Yes, No Cost EMI is available on orders above Rs. 3,000 with major credit cards and select debit cards.
